contentList.content: Convert 20% of <font color='#F96C26'>fire</font> damage you take into healing.

You're heating up!
Removed when you critically strike an enemy.

Shoot three flaming daggers in a row, each setting Warm. Deals a total of [1].

Capstone Effects
Soul Kindling(Pyrokinetic 4) -
Respark (Pyrokinetic 4) - When Searing Daggers deals direct damage to an enemy, it resets the cooldown of Ignition.

Set enemy characters on fire around you and deal [1]. Ignite all susceptible surfaces.

Capstone Effects

Infernal Command (Pyrokinetic 3)
Ignition critically strikes burning enemies.

Soul Kindling (Pyrokinetic 7)
Ignition critical strikes cause enemies to Bleed Fire for 3 turns.

Target gains Clear-Minded, which increases Strength, Finesse and Intelligence by [1] and Wits by [2]. Removes Blinded, Terrified, Charmed, Taunted, Sleeping, Enraged.

Capstone Effects

Phoenix's Blazing Sight (Pyrokinetic 6)
Your direct attacks and skills while Clear-Minded deal an additional 3% of your target's maximum vitality as Fire damage.

Awakened Fury (Pyrokinetic 10)
Whenever you critically strike with a Fire skill while Clear-Minded, you gain 1 AP.

Enemies in target area will bleed fire when hit. Create a small fire surface beneath each target.

Capstone Effects

Blood Boil (Pyrokinetic 1)
When you deal direct non-critical damage to enemies affected by Bleed Fire, you start Heating Up, granting [1]% critical strike chance. This effect stacks. Critical strikes consume this status.

Inner Fire (Polymorph 3)
When you consume Heating Up, you heal for [2] and gain Inner Warmth for 1 turn. Inner Warmth increases your Physical and Magical armor by [3] for each stack of Heating Up consumed.

Set Hasted on target character. Hasted increases movement speed by 2m per AP and gives an additional [2] AP per turn. Clears Slowed and Crippled.

Capstone Effects

Flame Strider (Pyrokinetic 2)
If you're both Burning and Hasted, you gain Flame Strider.

Rising Sun (Pyrokinetic 8)
When you start your turn with Flame Strider, you cast Ignition at no AP cost.
